text: Imports a Notion workspace via the Importer plugin and converts it to durable Markdown files usable offline and in other apps
quote: Obsidian lets you easily migrate your data from Notion using the Importer plugin. This converts your Notion workspace to durable Markdown files that you can use offline with Obsidian and many other apps.

text: Imports from Airtable, Microsoft OneNote, and Evernote as well as Notion
quote: Import from Notion|Notion - Import from Airtable|Airtable - Import from Microsoft OneNote|Microsoft OneNote - Import from Evernote|Evernote

text: A Notion account connection preserves databases and formulas by converting them to Bases
quote: Notion account (recommended) connects directly to your workspace and lets you preserve Databases and formulas which are converted to Bases.

text: Notes are stored locally as non-proprietary plain-text Markdown files, so they work offline and are easy to take to another app
quote: Obsidian uses non-proprietary plain text Markdown files stored locally on your device. You have total control over your data, which means you can use Obsidian offline and switch to another app easily

text: Notes are plain-text files, so other text editors and file managers can edit and manage them
quote: Because notes are plain text files, you can use other text editors and file managers to edit and manage notes.

text: Wikilinks can be turned off in favor of standard Markdown links for interoperability
quote: If interoperability is important to you, you can disable Wikilinks and use Markdown links instead.

text: Linking notes builds a network of knowledge
quote: By linking notes, you can create a network of knowledge.

text: Internal links are updated automatically when a file is renamed
quote: Obsidian can automatically update internal links in your vault when you rename a file.

text: Graph view visualizes the relationships between notes in a vault
quote: Graph view is a core plugin that lets you visualize the relationships between the notes in your vault.

text: Daily notes opens a note for today's date, creating it if it doesn't exist
quote: Daily notes is a core plugin that opens a note based on today's date, or creates it if it doesn't exist.

text: Daily notes can be organized into folders automatically using the date format
quote: You can automatically organize your daily notes into folders using the Date format feature.

text: Templates insert predefined text snippets into the active note
quote: Templates is a core plugin that lets you insert pre-defined snippets of text into your active note.

text: Templates can include dynamic information through template variables
quote: You can add dynamic information to your templates, using template variables.

text: Bases let you view, edit, sort, and filter files and their properties in database-like views
quote: Using a base you can view, edit, sort, and filter files and their properties.

text: A Kanban view shows files as cards in columns grouped by a property
quote: Kanban - Display files as cards organized into columns based on a grouped property.

text: Search filters notes by a search term
quote: Search files lets you filter notes based on a search term.

text: Multiple folders can be opened as separate vaults, for example to keep work and school notes apart
quote: You can open multiple folders as individual vaults, for example to separate notes for work and school.

text: Community-built plugins extend Obsidian, for example with extra file formats or third-party integrations
quote: Learn how to extend Obsidian with plugins built by the community.

text: Developers can build plugins in TypeScript to extend Obsidian's functionality
quote: Build plugins to extend the existing functionality in Obsidian using TypeScript.

text: A tutorial walks through compiling a sample plugin from source and loading it into Obsidian
quote: you'll compile a sample plugin from source code and load it into Obsidian.

text: The plugin API includes a Vault interface for working with files and folders
quote: Vault, the interface that lets you interact with files and folders in the vault.

text: Custom themes and snippets can be designed with CSS
quote: Design beautiful themes and snippets for Obsidian using CSS.

text: Restricted Mode is on by default and blocks third-party code from running
quote: By default, Obsidian runs in Restricted Mode to prevent third-party code execution.

text: A custom Obsidian URI protocol triggers actions such as opening or creating a note
quote: Obsidian URI is a custom URI protocol supported by Obsidian that lets you trigger various actions, such as opening a note or creating a note.

text: Obsidian Sync, an add-on service, privately syncs notes across devices
quote: Obsidian Sync is an add-on service that allows you to privately sync your notes across devices.

text: Sync uses end-to-end encryption by default, so not even the Obsidian team can access notes
quote: End-to-end encryption (default) offers the strongest security... This guarantees that no one — not even the Obsidian team — can access your notes.

text: Selective sync controls which files and settings are synced
quote: Selective sync - Configure which files and settings to sync.

text: A headless Sync client syncs vaults without the desktop app, for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows
quote: Obsidian Sync offers a headless client to sync vaults without using the desktop app. Useful for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows.

text: Vaults can also sync through third-party services such as Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive, and Git
quote: Obsidian syncs with Obsidian Sync, Dropbox, iCloud, OneDrive, Git, and many other third-party services.

text: Teams can collaborate on a shared vault through Obsidian Sync
quote: With Obsidian Sync you can collaborate on a shared vault with your team.

text: Version history lets you view or restore previous versions of a note
quote: Version history - View or restore previous versions of a note.

text: Obsidian Publish hosts selected notes as a wiki, knowledge base, documentation site, or digital garden
quote: Obsidian Publish is a cloud-based hosting service that lets you publish your notes as a wiki, knowledge base, documentation, or digital garden.

text: Published sites can use your own custom domain
quote: Custom domains - Set up Publish with your own domain.

text: A free Web Clipper browser extension highlights pages and saves web content to the vault
quote: Obsidian Web Clipper is a free browser extension that lets you highlight pages and save web content to your vault.

text: The Web Clipper supports custom templates for specific websites
quote: Templates - Create custom templates for specific websites.

text: Obsidian Mobile brings the desktop app's capabilities to mobile devices
quote: Obsidian Mobile brings the power of our desktop app to your mobile devices.

text: The mobile editing toolbar can be customized by reordering and removing actions
quote: Under Manage toolbar options, use the grip handles to reorder actions and the remove buttons to remove them.

text: The app is free with no limits and no sign-up required
quote: Free without limits. No sign-up required. No strings attached.
